optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_check_queue_depth(queue=InventoryUpdatesQueue) → visible=0, in_flight=0 — queue never received messages

ace_get_environment_variables(function=CSVProcessingToSQSFunction) → SQS_QUEUE_URL contains inventory-queue-v2 instead of inventory-queue
observable_symptom: Parser was invoked and ran, but no messages reached the work queue; consumer was never triggered; parser logs show a queue-not-found error on send
root_cause: SQS_QUEUE_URL environment variable is set to a hardcoded URL referencing a non-existent queue (inventory-queue-v2 suffix). The parser's send_message_batch call fails with QueueDoesNotExist. The real queue's event source mapping is healthy but never receives messages because the parser sends to the wrong endpoint.
